prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up, over-the-shoulder view of a person holding a white smartphone in their right hand, with the screen facing the camera. The phone displays a messaging or social media app, showing a message with text and a small image of a potted plant and a decorative object on a blue surface. The person is seated, with their legs visible in the foreground, wearing light gray plaid pants. The background is softly blurred, featuring a clean, modern setting with a white floor and a purple accent, possibly a rug or mat, in the upper part of the frame. The lighting is bright and natural, creating a fresh, airy atmosphere. The color palette is dominated by soft whites, grays, and subtle purples, with a hint of color from the phone screen. The composition uses a shallow depth of field to focus attention on the hand and phone, while the relaxed posture and casual clothing evoke a sense of comfort and everyday life. The overall style is contemporary and minimalistic, with a slight top-down camera angle that enhances the sense of intimacy and immediacy.
